If v has mixed signs, nonnegativity bounds I within [-N0,N0]. With integer H>=2+N0*(1+V), every population coordinate on that segment is <=H. For t,t+g in I, g>=1, the factorial ratios imply

Set qlo=eta/(16H^S), qhi=16H^S/eta. Comparing to a=min I and b=max I, summing k*(eta/16)^k gives f(qlo)<=tau+eta and f(qhi)>=tau-eta for every feasible tau. No enumeration or acquisition of a,b is needed.
